title: Dates from a Zapier Formatter step are off by several hours
symptoms: Event times shifted by the UTC offset
9:00 local becomes 9:00 UTC in the destination app
Correct in some Zaps, wrong in others
cause: Formatter assumes the input is UTC when From Timezone is empty and outputs UTC by default, and a new account timezone is UTC until changed.
fix: Set From Format, From Timezone and To Timezone on every date transform, and set the account or Zap timezone.
apply: Formatter > Date / Time > Format: From Format = YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm, From Timezone = America/Chicago, To Timezone = America/Chicago
affected: Formatter by Zapier, all plans, as of 2026-10
